create_bitmapmasks_from_ndarray: create BitmapMasks instance from a numpy ndarray of shape N x H x W with height and width
create_polygonmasks_from_list: create PolygonMasks instance from a nested list of polygon coordinate arrays with height and width
crop_and_resize_bitmapmasks: crop and resize BitmapMasks by given bounding boxes using roi_align to a target output shape
convert_polygon_to_bitmap: convert polygon masks to bitmap representation using pycocotools maskUtils frPyObjects and decode
rescale_bitmapmasks_with_interpolation: rescale BitmapMasks to a target scale using nearest or bilinear interpolation while keeping aspect ratio
